profile.summary: Computer Science undergraduate at UTAR building mobile and full-stack systems, from face-recognition attendance to community resource sharing.
about: I am a final-semester Computer Science student at Universiti Tunku Abdul Rahman with a broad foundation across Python, Java, C++, PHP and JavaScript. Most of what I have built has been end to end: a mobile or web front end, a backend I wrote myself, and a database schema designed around the problem rather than bolted on afterwards.

My final year project pushed that furthest: a React Native attendance system backed by Python, using YuNet for face detection, ArcFace for recognition, and an anti-spoofing model to stop fraudulent check-ins. I am now looking for an internship where I can apply that analytical and problem-solving work in a professional team and keep learning quickly.

projects.title: Face Recognition Attendance System
projects.tagline: Real-time attendance tracking with deep-learning face recognition and anti-spoofing.
projects.problem: Attendance taken by hand or by card is slow to collect and easy to fake — someone else signs you in, and a system that only matches a face can be fooled by holding up a photo of one.
projects.approach: A React Native app backed by a Python service. YuNet locates the face, ArcFace turns it into an embedding to match against enrolled users, and an anti-spoofing model runs first so a printed photo or a replayed video is rejected before recognition is even attempted. PocketBase holds the user profiles and biometric logs.

projects.title: CharityLink
projects.tagline: Community resource sharing with peer-to-peer posting and real-time chat.
projects.problem: Usable things get thrown away because passing them on takes more effort than binning them — there is no easy way to find the person nearby who wants what you no longer need.
projects.approach: A React Native app built around peer-to-peer item posting and a real-time chat module, so the handover gets arranged inside the app rather than somewhere else. I designed the layouts, the interactive user flows and the original brand logos in Figma, and used a lightweight Firebase backend for authentication and live data instead of standing up a server of my own.

projects.title: Student Co-curricular Management System
projects.tagline: A university web application for managing student activities.
projects.problem: Student co-curricular activities and the records behind them needed one place to be created, updated and reported on, rather than being tracked separately by everyone involved.
projects.approach: A full-stack PHP and MySQL web application, co-developed with a coursemate. I created the relational database schemas and wrote the server-side CRUD operations that render the data dynamically across the system.

projects.title: Stock Management System
projects.tagline: Retail inventory tracking for appliance stock levels, written in Java.
projects.problem: Appliance stock levels need to be tracked and adjusted reliably, with the rules about items and quantities living in one place rather than spread through the interface.
projects.approach: A Java application applying object-oriented principles throughout — inventory, items and operations are modelled as classes, so the architecture stays reusable and modular instead of becoming one long procedure.
